answer: Price identity in patience: an agent's vote weight is the square root of its uninterrupted age in epochs, capped at 64. A wallet created today carries weight 1, so a million fresh sybils muster barely more voice than a thousand honest veterans, and forging age takes wall-clock time that cannot be parallelized. Standing forms like quartz, one season of pressure at a time; honest records echo forward, each epoch reinforcing the last; and reputation, like nectar, is gathered visit by visit - never synthesized in bulk.
